command:
import json,hashlib,numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
d=json.loads(Path('/mnt/trusted.json').read_text());p=Path('/source/predictions.json');assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==d['predictions_sha256'];records=json.loads(p.read_text());assert len(records)==100;points=[];flags=[]
for row in d['rows']:
 p=Path('/tmp/native')/row['artifact'];assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==row['sha256']
 with np.load(p,allow_pickle=False) as a:points.append(a['xyz'].copy());flags.append(a['nlz'].copy())
points=np.concatenate(points);flags=np.concatenate(flags);assert len(points)==180827
for r in records:
 b=np.array(r['box']);c,s=np.cos(b[6]),np.sin(b[6]);local=(points-b[:3])@np.array([[c,s,0],[-s,c,0],[0,0,1]]).T;inside=(np.abs(local)<=b[3:6]/2).all(axis=1)
 assert int(inside.sum())==r['num_lidar_points_in_box'];assert bool(np.any(inside&(flags==1)))==r['overlap_with_nlz'];assert r['difficulty'] is None
report={'predictions':len(records),'measured_points':len(points),'predictions_sha256':d['predictions_sha256'],'result':'all prediction counts/NLZ independently recomputed from original ten returns'};Path('/outputs/check.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2));print('PASS independent geometry metadata',report)

checks.name: scoring
command:
import json,hashlib,subprocess,re,importlib.util
from pathlib import Path
from pipeline.detection_export import export_objects
assert importlib.util.find_spec('tensorflow') is None
d=json.loads(Path('/mnt/trusted.json').read_text());p=Path('/source/predictions.json');assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==d['predictions_sha256'];records=json.loads(p.read_text());truth=Path('/tmp/real-boxes.json');assert hashlib.sha256(truth.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==d['groundtruth_sha256'];gt=[r for r in json.loads(truth.read_text()) if r['context_name']==d['rows'][0]['context'] and r['frame_timestamp_micros']==d['rows'][0]['timestamp']];assert len(gt)==45
out=Path('/outputs');(out/'predictions.bin').write_bytes(export_objects(records));(out/'groundtruth.bin').write_bytes(export_objects(gt))
for name,expected in [('predictions',records),('groundtruth',gt)]:
 r=subprocess.run(['protoc','--proto_path=/upstream/src','--decode=waymo.open_dataset.Objects','waymo_open_dataset/protos/metrics.proto'],input=(out/(name+'.bin')).read_bytes(),capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0;blocks=re.split(r'^objects \{\n',r.stdout.decode(),flags=re.M)[1:];assert len(blocks)==len(expected)
 for block,record in zip(blocks,expected):
  assert re.search(r'context_name: "([^"\n]+)"',block)[1]==record['context_name'];assert int(re.search(r'frame_timestamp_micros: (\d+)',block)[1])==record['frame_timestamp_micros'];assert abs(float(re.search(r'\bscore: ([^\s]+)',block)[1])-record['score'])<1e-6
r=subprocess.run(['/metrics-build/compute_detection_metrics','/outputs/predictions.bin','/outputs/groundtruth.bin'],capture_output=True,text=True);(out/'metrics.stdout').write_text(r.stdout);(out/'metrics.stderr').write_text(r.stderr);assert r.returncode==0 and 'mAP' in r.stdout
report={'predictions':len(records),'native_groundtruth_boxes':len(gt),'scope':'untrained diagnostic engineering-frame native scoring only; zero optimizer steps, no accuracy/held-out research claim'};(out/'check.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2));print('PASS native scoring',report)
